subject: Geografia
description_pt: Analisar transformações de paisagens nas cidades, comparando sequência de fotografias, fotografias aéreas e imagens de satélite de épocas diferentes.

components.description_pt: Interpretar sequências de fotografias para analisar transformações de paisagem em cidades ao longo do tempo
components.description_en: Interpret sequences of photographs to analyze landscape transformations in cities over time
components.cc_component_description: Interpret data showing trends in human impact scale over time

components.description_pt: Analisar fotografias aéreas e imagens de satélite para identificar mudanças de paisagem urbana
components.description_en: Analyze aerial photographs and satellite images to identify urban landscape changes
components.cc_component_description: Analyze geoscience data to identify a change occurring at Earth's surface

components.description_pt: Comparar transformações de paisagem urbana em diferentes períodos históricos usando fontes visuais
components.description_en: Compare urban landscape transformations across different time periods using visual sources
components.cc_component_description: Compare rates of change across different systems or time periods to identify patterns

cc_matches.description: Though the magnitudes of human impacts are greater than they have ever been, so too are human abilities to model, predict, and manage current and future impacts.
Analyze geoscience data to make the claim that one change to Earth's surface can create feedbacks that cause changes to other Earth systems.
Change is measured in terms of differences over time and may occur at different rates.
